rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=100, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=8, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=30, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=1.0, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-11 RE-DISPATCH (breast_ct). The prior iter-11 (K=30, val_n=200, epochs=10) was CANCELLED at the 30-min TIME LIMIT (job 772264 reached only epoch 7) -- K=30 val over 200 slices + train blew the wall. Same hypothesis, budget-fitted. DEPTH x strong-lambda: lambda axis plateaued (0.05->hr0.1195, 0.2->0.1462, 1.0->0.1471) with step->0 so only TV smoothing acts; more K = more TV-denoising passes now that lambda is the ACTIVE lever. ONE KNOB vs the iter-10 winner (K=10 lambda=1.0 hr=0.1471): tv_K 10->30. BUDGET CUT to fit the 20-min wall (NOT extra knobs, just sizing): val_n 200->100 (halves the K=30 val pass) and epochs 10->8; the prior run showed lambda already at ~1.0 by epoch 6 so 8 epochs suffices. HYPOTHESIS: 30 TV passes denoise further than 10 so hr rises above 0.1471. NOTE val_n=100 vs 200 slightly changes the val set (evenly-spaced subset) so hr is ~comparable but not identical; the winner will be re-confirmed at val_n=200 if it leads. FALSIFIER: hr saturates ~0.147 -> per-pass TV converged by K=10, depth redundant. BUDGET: K=30 x100 slices x epochs8 -> est ~750-900s, under 1200s wall.
